WITH pagamentos_agg AS (
  SELECT
    num_doc_credor,
    nom_credor,
    SUM(CAST(vlr_pag_fonte AS DECIMAL)) AS total_pago
  FROM despesa_pagamento
  WHERE ano_referencia = 2024
    AND COALESCE(nom_credor, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%'
    AND num_doc_credor NOT IN ('-1', '0', '')
  GROUP BY num_doc_credor, nom_credor
),
transferencias_agg AS (
  SELECT
    "CÓDIGO FAVORECIDO" AS num_doc_credor_cgu,
    "NOME FAVORECIDO" AS nom_credor_cgu,
    SUM(CAST("VALOR TRANSFERIDO" AS DECIMAL)) AS total_transferido
  FROM cgu_transferencias
  WHERE ano_referencia = 2024
  GROUP BY "CÓDIGO FAVORECIDO", "NOME FAVORECIDO"
)
SELECT
  p.nom_credor,
  p.num_doc_credor,
  p.total_pago,
  t.total_transferido
FROM pagamentos_agg p
JOIN transferencias_agg t
  ON p.num_doc_credor = t.num_doc_credor_cgu
ORDER BY p.total_pago DESC
LIMIT 3;
